title: Recovery, response and maintenance actions
description: Actions form a tree: atomic actions are leaves with concrete requirements; composite actions combine other actions with all_of, any_of or k_of_n. The engine executes these trees: the access goals of AccessModel.json name the actions that say what spending a wallet, obtaining a secret or having a descriptor needs, and the same trees give the dependencies of a wallet, the cut sets of the deductive analysis and the steps of the manuals. Actions are parameterised by entities of the setup ontology; arguments and expressions are written as `$name` or `$name.attribute.path` and are resolved against the plan, following references and the derived attributes of AccessModel.json. Which actions help against which threat is stored here (`responds_to`), not in the threat catalogue.

class.description: Ontology class (including the nested parts Signer, SpendingPolicy, BackupItem), or Number; the loader checks it.

type.description: reach: physical access to a Location, bag, device or backup, including the containers it sits in (decided by Location.access); for the attacker: the item is disclosed or controlled. have: a tool or capability from the vocabulary in `what`; never a barrier in the analysis. wait: a delay in blocks. intact: the item still exists and is unmodified (strict evaluation: and is not unavailable); always true for the attacker. known: the attacker has the secret itself (it leaked); never true for the rightful people.

foreach.description: Repeat the step for every element of the collection and bind it to `as`.

class.description: Class of the bound items when it cannot be told from the collection (nested parts).

when.description: Only if the expression is present in the plan, or if the condition holds.

optional.description: The step is good practice but not needed to complete the action; the analysis skips it, the manuals show it.

guards.description: The entity this step protects: an attacker who controls that entity does not need the step (a PIN on a swapped device, a password on a coordinator whose host runs malware).

purpose.description: access: obtain the ability to use funds or information. restore: rebuild a lost element. response: react to an incident. maintenance: recurring upkeep. setup: create something new.

for.description: attacker: a step that only models the attacker's side (leaked knowledge); left out of the manuals.

requires.description: Atoms the action needs; a composite action may add atoms to its steps.

combinator.description: Composite actions only. all_of: every step. any_of: one alternative suffices. k_of_n: at least k steps (usually over a foreach).
